_doc: Rules for bin/heavy and the heavy-jobs omp extension. A command is split into simple commands (on && || ; | and newlines); VAR=value prefixes and env/nice/time/timeout/command wrappers are dropped; each rule pattern must then match at the start of a simple command, after an optional directory prefix (./gradlew, /usr/bin/cargo, web/node_modules/.bin/tsc). Class "none" anywhere means never broker (watchers, dev servers). If several simple commands match, the most memory-hungry class sets the resources and the command is cacheable only if every match is. It runs in the shell lane (bin/lane: the Android shell user, which may use more cores than the app) only if every match has "lane": true (output-only checks), the line is side-effect free and the lane is set up; HEAVY_LANE=off keeps it local. Patterns must be valid in both Python re and JavaScript RegExp. mem_mb/cpu are first guesses; the broker learns real peaks per command. reserve_mb and mem_mb were measured on a reference phone with ~11 GB MemTotal; bin/heavy scales them linearly to this phone's MemTotal at load (`heavy --help` prints the values in force). A repo may prepend rules in <git root>/.omp/heavy-jobs.json {"rules": [...]}.
